      <title>California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state</link>
      <description><p>Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded</p><p>Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.</p><p>Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/20/california-coastal-communities-alert-big-waves-hit-state">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/women-girls-rights-rape-sexual-violence-africa-marriage-unfpa</link>
      <description><p>Almost half of women in west and central Africa cannot withhold consent, with girls worst affected, UNFPA finds</p><p>One in four women around the world have no power of consent if their husband or partner demands sex, according to a UN report.</p><p>In west and central Africa, almost half of women (45%) are not able to say no in their own marriage, while a third of women (33%) in east and southern Africa and in Arab states face the same predicament.       <description><p>Leaked documents raise questions about claims Egypt met welfare targets to qualify for €2.5bn in loans</p><p>The European Commission has been accused of sugarcoating figures to enable it to release funds to Egypt under a landmark pact with the authoritarian government of Abdel Fatah al-Sisi.</p><p>The charge relates to a €7.4bn deal <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/17/egypt-eu-deal-refugees-mediterranean">promised by Ursula von der Leyen</a>, the European Commission president, to al-Sisi on a high-profile visit to Cairo in 2024.       <description><p>Debate about dominance of permanent five members could reignite if major powers block Costa Rican frontrunner</p><p>The race to become the next UN secretary general could reach a decisive moment on Friday when a UN security council vote is likely to reveal whether the Costa Rican frontrunner for the post would be blocked by the big powers.       <description><p>Week-long efforts fail to establish negotiating mandate on AI warfare after Russian ‘filibustering’</p><p>Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am after all-night talks failed to overcome Russian objections.</p><p>Despite an overwhelming majority of states at the UN’s Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW) in Geneva wanting to agree a negotiating mandate leading to a legally binding treaty, the need for consensus forced the conference to adopt a much weaker option.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/21/international-talks-control-ai-autonomous-weapons-collapse">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/kyiv-russian-attacks-bridges</link>
      <description><p>Despite dodging tears in the tarmac, people are confident in city’s infrastructure – and will not worry about what has not happened yet</p><p>Mykola expects to drive his battered beige passenger minibus 20 to 24 times a day past the holes in the road on Kyiv’s damaged Northern Bridge that were caused by a Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday.</p><p>Buses are now the only motor transport allowed across the normally busy multi-lane crossing, though on their way into the city centre they have to skirt the tears in the tarmac, using the only functioning lane to get by.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/21/kyiv-russian-attacks-bridges">Continue reading...</a></description>

The latest information, news and events in France, Europe and around the world.</description><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:54:06 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>France</category><title>Students and unions unite for sixth weekend of protests across France</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-students-and-unions-unite-for-sixth-weekend-of-protests-across-france</link><description>
Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across France on Saturday for a sixth consecutive weekend of protests against rising living costs, deteriorating public services and growing inequality. The movement, which began with student demonstrations in September, has since broadened into a nationwide campaign and inspired similar rallies elsewhere in Europe.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/1a778cb4-e5b3-11f1-a8b6-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88M7VC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/1a778cb4-e5b3-11f1-a8b6-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88M7VC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">7ad79414-e5c2-11f1-8bc6-7d93519529c2</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:43:57 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/1a778cb4-e5b3-11f1-a8b6-ebb478925cf0/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88M7VC.jpg">AFP - GUILLAUME SALIGOT</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French court finds racism played role in police beating of black music producer</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-french-court-finds-racism-played-role-in-police-beating-of-black-music-producer</link><description>
A French court has handed down prison sentences to three police officers for the violent assault of black music producer Michel Zecler in Paris in 2020, ruling that racism was an aggravating factor in a case that sparked nationwide outrage over police brutality and racial discrimination.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/17c071ac-e4f5-11f1-9df3-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-20T101436Z-2082553690-RC2LROA9VG3U-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-JUSTICE-ZECLER.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/17c071ac-e4f5-11f1-9df3-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-20T101436Z-2082553690-RC2LROA9VG3U-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-JUSTICE-ZECLER.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">eadc87ac-e58a-11f1-b7fe-efd3e07e368d</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:41:58 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/17c071ac-e4f5-11f1-9df3-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-20T101436Z-2082553690-RC2LROA9VG3U-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-JUSTICE-ZECLER.jpg">REUTERS - Benoit Tessier</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>National Assembly backs greater legal protection for police using firearms</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-national-assembly-backs-greater-legal-protection-for-police-using-firearms</link><description>
France's parliament has approved legislation giving police officers greater legal protection when using their firearms, prompting fierce criticism from rights groups who warn it could make it harder to investigate alleged police brutality. The government insists the measure is needed to protect officers carrying out increasingly demanding duties.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/07ce511e-d53d-11f1-ab78-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T142906Z-217842348-RC2CEOAPZ05N-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/07ce511e-d53d-11f1-ab78-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T142906Z-217842348-RC2CEOAPZ05N-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">a15be40c-e589-11f1-9ce2-a7af964aafae</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:44:03 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/07ce511e-d53d-11f1-ab78-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-31T142906Z-217842348-RC2CEOAPZ05N-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">REUTERS - Nicolas Economou</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Former PM de Villepin launches 2027 presidential bid with warning to far right</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-former-pm-de-villepin-launches-20207-presidential-bid-with-warning-to-far-right</link><description>
Former French prime minister Dominique de Villepin has announced his candidacy for the 2027 presidential election, promising to restore France's international influence, tackle growing inequality and challenge the rise of the far right. The veteran conservative also delivered a blistering assessment of President Emmanuel Macron's leadership, accusing him of allowing the country's political and social divisions to deepen.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">cf6f11fc-e589-11f1-b2ac-0d673b4c7b00</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:02:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/bedb7fd4-e4ed-11f1-9e70-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26324386665816.jpg">AP Photo/Aurelien Morissard - Aurelien Morissard</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France must change or 'risk losing' overseas territories, former PM tells RFI</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261121-france-must-change-or-risk-losing-overseas-territories-former-pm-tells-rfi-manuel-valls</link><description>
France's territories outside Europe are a major strategic asset, giving it a foothold on five continents and in three oceans. Yet Paris has long been accused of neglecting the nearly 3 million people living outside mainland France, who face deep economic and social inequalities. With calls for independence growing, former prime minister Manuel Valls warns that France risks losing its overseas territories unless it radically changes its relationship with them.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c2eb5f78-e343-11f1-ac1e-392da9561c55</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:31:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5b00a846-f5b5-11ef-a324-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_36YE3UC.jpg">© AFP - DELPHINE MAYEUR </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French Greens candidate gives hard-left Mélenchon a boost in presidential race</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-french-greens-candidate-gives-hard-left-melenchon-a-boost-in-presidential-race</link><description>
French hard-left presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has said an alliance with the Greens "should be possible", after the head of the Greens tentatively agreed to back him, angering moderates on the centre-left. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">40b0fb0e-e4dc-11f1-a123-31d05317ef57</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:04:55 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/803220b8-e4e7-11f1-a2f9-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-19T085824Z-1059669313-RC2NXNA8BALJ-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS-GREENS.jpg">© REUTERS - Tom Nicholson </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Depardieu and Houellebecq accused of gang rape on French film set</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-depardieu-and-houellebecq-accused-of-gang-rape-on-french-film-set</link><description>
Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation after an actress filed a complaint alleging that she was raped by a group including actor Gérard Depardieu and high-profile French author Michel Houellebecq on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec3acb0c-e4dd-11f1-9619-3935a39ed096</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:24:55 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5f6cabe8-e1a7-11f1-8f6a-3f371022a770/w:1024/p:16x9/gerry.jpg">REUTERS - Gonzalo Fuentes</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France probes suspected leaks from interior ministry to far-right National Rally</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-france-probes-suspected-leaks-from-interior-ministry-to-far-right-national-rally</link><description>
France has opened a probe into suspicions that a senior official at the interior ministry leaked secret information to the far-right National Rally (RN) party, which is itself facing a number of investigations, prosecutors have said.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5be0a25a-e4b2-11f1-be46-714476ef8919</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:55:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0777260e-e45c-11f1-a6ff-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg">© Pascal Guyot / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French union leader warns strikes will continue without higher wages</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261120-french-union-leader-warns-strikes-will-continue-without-higher-wages-cgt-sophie-binet-interview</link><description>
French trade unions have promised to call more strikes and demonstrations, arguing that a government proposal to increase the minimum wage fails to address the social crisis that has spurred protests across the country. Sophie Binet, head of the CGT union, says even after six weeks of action, workers and students are more determined than ever to keep up the fight.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">37c8b342-e40f-11f1-a821-bd0c1d2fd9c6</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 06:07:21 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/60fce194-d932-11f1-aa3d-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-05T160039Z-986160219-RC2PHOAZFNU3-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">© REUTERS - Sarah Meyssonnier </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Spotlight on France</category><title>Podcast: Living on the breadline, France's 35-hour week and a divisive tax</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/podcasts/spotlight-on-france/20261119-podcast-living-on-minimum-wage-smic-35-hour-working-week-france-second-biggest-tax-csg</link><description>
The French government's decision to raise the minimum wage has failed to satisfy protesters struggling to make ends meet amid the cost-of-living crisis. Also, did the introduction of the 35-hour working week actually help reduce unemployment? The evidence is mixed. And a look at the history of France's second-largest tax, the CSG, and why it's dividing politicians. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8a275ba4-e41c-11f1-8716-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-153-light-blue.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/8a275ba4-e41c-11f1-8716-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/episode-spotlight-on-france-episode-153-light-blue.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">da07160a-e41c-11f1-9424-dd481487d627</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:19:04 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Sarah Elzas</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France raises bird flu alert to highest level as infections spread across Europe</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261119-france-raises-bird-flu-alert-to-highest-level-as-infections-spread-across-europe</link><description>
France is raising its avian flu alert to the highest level from Friday, bringing new restrictions on poultry movements as authorities seek to contain the spread of the virus. The decision comes amid a rise in infections among wild birds across Europe, particularly along migration routes crossing France.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">eff2afda-e3f7-11f1-a0c0-bdb47d3d53b3</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:12:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/42222ee2-1fab-11eb-b845-005056bf87d6/w:1024/p:16x9/6850244_699464634-000-ft7gh.png">© GAIZKA IROZ / AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France rejects 'absurd' Russian claims of direct involvement in Ukraine war</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261118-france-rejects-absurd-russian-claims-of-direct-involvement-in-ukraine-war</link><description>
The French government on Tuesday dismissed Russian accusations that France is directly involved in the war in Ukraine, following an RFI investigation which revealed a small number of French soldiers have been carrying out training and equipment maintenance missions on Ukrainian territory. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/746c6ae0-4ac3-11f1-935e-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000-89T43XG.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/746c6ae0-4ac3-11f1-935e-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000-89T43XG.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ffdd448e-e346-11f1-831b-65a66bd770f6</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:39:09 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/746c6ae0-4ac3-11f1-935e-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000-89T43XG.jpg">AFP - BERTRAND GUAY</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French interior minister accused of 'exaggerating' police protest injury figures</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261118-french-interior-minister-accused-of-exaggerating-police-protest-injury-figures</link><description>
A group of lawyers have called for an investigation into French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez who they accuse of "spreading false information" about the number of injuries suffered by law enforcement officers since the start of the current protest movement, which they say was used "to justify a disproportionate use of force" against high school protesters.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0622d13a-dad5-11f1-9395-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6RB3AC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0622d13a-dad5-11f1-9395-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6RB3AC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">294b16e6-e335-11f1-af18-6757e9484dfb</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:09:32 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/0622d13a-dad5-11f1-9395-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6RB3AC.jpg">AFP - SEBASTIEN BOZON</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>'We weren't afraid of the future': France's student protests today and in May '68</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261118-we-weren-t-afraid-of-the-future-france-s-student-protests-today-and-in-may-68</link><description>
As students across France continue demonstrating against conditions in schools, the movement has drawn inevitable comparisons with the biggest student protests in the country's history – those of May 1968. Tens of thousands of people demonstrated across France on Tuesday in a fresh nationwide public sector strike over pay and the cost of living. </description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1164fca6-abc0-11f1-a24c-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C79B3WE-1.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1164fca6-abc0-11f1-a24c-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C79B3WE-1.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b85f821e-bc10-11f1-89fe-7b0f1abdd3bc</guid><pubDate>Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:22:29 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1164fca6-abc0-11f1-a24c-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C79B3WE-1.jpg">© Kenzo Tribouillard, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France's Le Pen vows to 'counterattack' after top ally Bardella hit by anti-Semitism claims</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260929-france-s-le-pen-vows-to-counterattack-after-top-ally-bardella-hit-by-anti-semitism-claims</link><description>
French presidential frontrunner Marine Le Pen on Tuesday denounced an attempt to "derail" her Élysée Palace run after a media report accused the head of her far-right National Rally (RN) party, Jordan Bardella, of making ant-Semitic comments in 2013. Le Pen said Bardella, who is tipped to be prime minister if she wins the presidency, had her "total confidence".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0b97a704-bc02-11f1-8bbb-ad34ceb9e2f1</guid><pubDate>Tue, 29 Sep 2026 12:33:58 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0a9f2142-bc02-11f1-802a-177f79e345bf/w:1024/p:16x9/191c2d6c2fa59b9137ed69f72204c81d237ccfd9.jpg">© Anne-Christine Poujoulat, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France puts out massive fire that torched 42,000 hectares and smouldered for 69 days</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260928-france-puts-out-massive-fire-that-torched-42-000-hectares-and-smouldered-for-69-days</link><description>
France's largest wildfire since 1949 has been declared extinguished more than two months after it broke out in southwestern Gironde, forcing the evacuation of around 224,000 people and covering the city of Bordeaux with a thick plume of smoke. The blaze was put under control on August 1, but continued to smoulder underground for weeks.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0f68114c-bb5e-11f1-a5f5-19c8c18b5c0d</guid><pubDate>Mon, 28 Sep 2026 17:00:08 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0e7d8b7c-bb5e-11f1-99d0-11fa9f8a3b4f/w:1024/p:16x9/b0f91c8b5c330512b36891557fe227255f531c13.jpg">© Julien De Rosa, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Far-right politician Éric Zemmour joins 2027 French presidential race</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260918-far-right-politician-%C3%A9ric-zemmour-joins-2027-french-presidential-race</link><description>
French far-right politician Éric Zemmour said on Friday that he would run in next year's presidential election, joining far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, who was runner-up to President Emmanuel Macron in the last two elections. Zemmour is campaigning on a crackdown on immigration, including a plan to expel unemployed foreigners even if they are legal residents. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2e6bcd08-b33a-11f1-b960-e76b244d1c83</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:06:31 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/23bd41de-b33a-11f1-afa9-2538446acac2/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26008389563206.jpg">© Emma Da Silva, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French PM vows to cut public spending by €54 billion to reduce deficit</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260918-french-pm-vows-to-cut-public-spending-by-%E2%82%AC54-billion-to-reduce-deficit</link><description>
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said on Thursday that France will cut public spending by €54 billion next year to reduce the country's deficit. The announcement comes seven months ahead of the country's presidential election, and the government is wary of a new wave of demonstrations with a jump in global oil prices sparking concerns over the rising cost of living. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">61b975d6-b32e-11f1-ab9e-b5bbc83805db</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 07:23:41 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP via AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

      <title>Raya injured but Madueke rescues point for Arsenal in seesaw Newcastle draw</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/newcastle-arsenal-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p>If Mikel Arteta was delighted to see the back of Eddie Howe as Newcastle’s head coach, the bad news is that another similarly awkward technical area adversary has been installed at St James’ Park.</p><p>Arsenal’s manager never seemed to relish trips to face Howe’s old team and he certainly did not enjoy this latest trip to Tyneside, where Matthias Jaissle’s initially overwhelmed team fought back commendably to earn a point courtesy of a stellar second-half performance. At half-time the crowd had felt close to turning against Jaissle but he held his nerve and, thanks to a triple substitution and subtle tactical rejig suggested he is no mug after all.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/newcastle-arsenal-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>‘Fragile’ Chelsea must toughen up after Leeds humiliation, admits Xabi Alonso</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/chelsea-leeds-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p></p><p>Xabi Alonso is straying towards crisis territory. Here’s a mind-bending statistic: Chelsea are eighth but have now lost more league games than Manchester United. They were bullied by a rampant Leeds United, who fully merited their first win at Stamford Bridge since going top with a 2-0 victory in December 1999, and can look forward to another season with no European football if they do not sharpen up soon.</p><p>It is not really worth dwelling on the fact that the second Leeds goal, a Dominic Calvert-Lewin penalty converted early in an astonishingly one-sided second half, came after Morgan Rogers was harshly penalised for handball. That was a minor detail given the wider picture. Leeds, superbly coached by Daniel Farke and up to sixth after two clinical strikes from Noah Okafor, Calvert-Lewin’s sixth goal of the season and a late effort from Brenden Aaronson, were so dominant that they had no real need for a helping hand from the officials.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/chelsea-leeds-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

    <item>
      <title>Coventry edge thriller to keep Crystal Palace bottom and ruin Thomas Frank’s start</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/coventry-crystal-palace-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p>New manager, new formation, familiar defensive failings. Twice Crystal Palace equalised. They seemed to have stabilised after half-time. But sometimes the rot is so deep-rooted <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/19/thomas-frank-crystal-palace-premier-league">that the new manager</a> bounce manifests as nothing more than it not looking quite as shambolic as it did before. Thomas Frank started with a defeat that means Palace remain bottom of the table having lost five league games in a row.</p><p>Yet for much of the second half, there had been reasons for Palace optimism. They seemed to have settled better after a ludicrous first half in which neither side looked at all capable of defending. But a triple substitution by Frank Lampard with 20 minutes to go shifted the game back in Coventry’s favour. With five minutes remaining, a long throw arced into the box. Brandon Thomas-Asante headed it goalwards. Dean Henderson got in the way but the ball bounced off him, hit Dwight McNeil and ricocheted in. “We came through with spirit,” Lampard said. “There was good play and a big impact from the subs. It’s a good sign for the squad.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/coventry-crystal-palace-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

    <item>
      <title>Aston Villa held at home as dogged Sunderland battle for Régis Le Bris</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/aston-villa-sunderland-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p>For <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/aston-villa">Aston Villa</a>, a painful stalemate at home to Sunderland, but for Régis Le Bris and his players, this was another triumph of sorts. The raw numbers spoke volumes of Villa’s struggles against a defence that backed themselves to keep Unai Emery’s side at bay. All but one of Villa’s seven shots on target came from outside the visitors’ box and the one inside it, courtesy of Ian Maatsen, was forgettable. Owing to a summer of change, injuries and Emery resting John McGinn with Tuesday’s game at Galatasaray in mind, Maatsen, incredibly, was the sole survivor in the Villa starting XI from when these sides played out a 4-3 classic seven months ago.</p><p>Villa were too predictable, short of a spark, someone to unpick an organised back line. Johan Manzambi, Emi Buendía and Alysson all flattered to deceive on an afternoon when Ibrahim Mbaye and McGinn arrived from the bench. Alejandro Garnacho, however, was not involved in Villa’s matchday squad for the second successive match and the Chelsea loanee has played just 38 minutes in the Premier League this campaign. Tammy Abraham, the match-winner in April, was also left out and a January move looks likely.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/aston-villa-sunderland-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/liverpool-chelsea-london-city-lionesses-crystal-palace-wsl</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Keating’s resilience keeps Chelsea at bay in 0-0 draw</p></li><li><p>Van de Donk and Putellas score twice to sink Palace 6-2</p></li></ul><p>Khiara Keating’s resilient performance in goal denied <strong><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/chelsea-women">Chelsea</a></strong>, the Women’s Super League leaders, and earned <strong>Liverpool</strong> a point, while <strong>London City Lionesses</strong> moved to within four points of the top by beating <strong>Crystal Palace</strong> 6-2.</p><p>After <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/14/chelsea-manchester-city-womens-super-league-match-report">hard-fought 1-0 wins against Manchester City</a> last Saturday and <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/18/chelsea-paris-saint-germain-womens-champions-league-match-report">Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday night</a>, Chelsea drew a blank. Against Gareth Taylor’s side, Chelsea’s lack of cutting edge was clear a week after they beat City to go top. The calf injury picked up by Melvine Malard against City, the absence of Lauren James, who has a thigh injury, and the form of Aggie Beever-Jones, who scored her first WSL goal in more than a year in the 6-0 defeat of Charlton, have left Chelsea’s attack short.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/liverpool-chelsea-london-city-lionesses-crystal-palace-wsl">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/elon-musk-lawyer-tom-brady-nfl-chelsea-stake</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Attorney also representing Joshua Kushner in Uefa battle</p></li><li><p>Clearlake Capital seeking additional investors</p></li></ul><p>Elon Musk’s lawyer is joining Tom Brady in buying a stake in Chelsea.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/21/tottenham-ipswich-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p>Not since the emergence of a certain Harry Kane has there been this much excitement about a player from Tottenham’s academy. On his first senior start, Luca Williams-Barnett showed just why as the 18-year-old became their youngest Premier League goalscorer since Gareth Bale in 2007 before teeing up Dominic Solanke with a mesmerising and match-winning assist against Ipswich.</p><p>That made it four league victories from their last five matches for Roberto De Zerbi’s side and the Italian could only have enjoyed the view from the stands as he served his one-match touchline ban.       <title>Washington Spirit provide hope and joy in a city that badly needs it</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/washington-spirit-provide-hope-and-joy-in-a-city-that-badly-needs-it</link>
      <description><p>Spirit’s run to the NWSL Championship final is in part based on a positive connection with fans at a time when DC is troubled in more ways than one</p><p>In the moments after the Washington Spirit’s 2-1 semi-final victory over the Utah Royals last weekend, all of Audi Field was in rapture. In the stands, around 20,000 Spirit supporters had filled the stadium to capacity, the sixth time they’d done so in 2026. They filled the place with the type of wondrous noise that’s become alien in DC sports in recent years, the type of gleeful adoration reserved for the city’s rare winners. The Spirit will return to their home stadium to face the Kansas City Current in the NWSL championship this Saturday.</p><p>In short order, the Spirit’s players made their way to the north end of the stadium, taking their celebrations into the crowd with their supporters. Perhaps no player has done more to push the Spirit into not only local but national relevance than US women’s national team forward Trinity Rodman, and Rodman herself grabbed a flag from a fan, jubilantly waving it above the crowd. Moments later, she bolted back onto the field and track down the club’s owner, Michele Kang, cajoling the businesswoman into a celebratory dance.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/20/washington-spirit-provide-hope-and-joy-in-a-city-that-badly-needs-it">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Union leaders from 19 countries urge reassessment of ties to Amazon, citing company’s poor record on worker rights</p><p>More than 30 labor union leaders from 19 countries are calling on governments to review their public contracts with Amazon and Amazon Web Services, citing the company’s poor record on worker rights and collective bargaining, in an<a href="https://uniglobalunion.org/wp-content/uploads/Amazon-procurement-letter-embargoed-until-nov-19.pdf"> open letter</a> published on Thursday.</p><p>“Amazon’s consistent record of disrespect for workers’ fundamental rights should disqualify it from being awarded public contracts – its behaviour is fundamentally inconsistent with the shared democratic values of our countries,” the union leaders wrote.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/nov/19/labor-unions-amazon-contracts-open-letter">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>A citizen referendum, only the second of its kind in Georgia history, seeks to block a zoning amendment</p><p>Ire Gene Grovner stood behind his house on a recent morning, between chicken pens on one side and rows of winter collard greens on the other, holding a knife and skinning a raccoon splayed across a wood post.</p><p>“The meat is good roasted,” Grovner said. En Ethiopie près de 700.000 personnes ont été déplacées par des affrontements entre forces armées des régions Somali et de l'Oromia qui font rage depuis près d'un mois dans le sud de l'Éthiopie, a annoncé jeudi l'ONG britannique Islamic Relief. Mais alors que les combats font rage au Tigré, 5000 étudiants de cette région ont demandé au ministère de l’éducation d’être affectés à de nouvelles universités. Ils craignaient d’être recrutés de force par les forces tigréennes. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e7626bd6-e5ef-11f1-8b37-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/DL00016516-VOD-00044982.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e7626bd6-e5ef-11f1-8b37-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/DL00016516-VOD-00044982.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">761440e6-e5f7-11f1-8768-b332da7dd14f</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 22:04:01 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Kalidou SY</dc:creator></item><item><category>Moyen-Orient</category><title>Israël : Gadi Eisenkot invite le parti de Benjamin Netanyahu à des négociations de coalition</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/moyen-orient/20261121-isra%C3%ABl-gadi-eisenkot-invite-le-parti-de-benjamin-netanyahu-%C3%A0-des-n%C3%A9gociations-de-coalition</link><description>
Le centriste Gadi Eisenkot, chargé de former le prochain gouvernement israélien, a invité le parti du premier ministre sortant, Benyamin Netanyahu à des pourparlers en vue d’une éventuelle coalition, a annoncé, samedi, son parti.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/70936d94-e5e9-11f1-943b-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6U96RP.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/70936d94-e5e9-11f1-943b-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6U96RP.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">30e8607c-e5ea-11f1-a254-39c32a8ef483</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:29:02 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/70936d94-e5e9-11f1-943b-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6U96RP.jpg">© Ilia Yefimovich, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Présidentielle : prenant "acte de l’impasse" de sa campagne, François Ruffin retire sa candidature</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261121-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-prenant-acte-de-l-impasse-de-sa-campagne-fran%C3%A7ois-ruffin-retire-sa-candidature</link><description>
À cinq mois de l’échéance, François Ruffin a annoncé samedi qu’il retirait sa candidature à l’élection présidentielle, prenant "acte de l’impasse" de sa campagne faute d’avoir réussi à imposer l’organisation d’une "grande primaire" de toute la gauche.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">34a0106a-e5d2-11f1-88ab-0f8d44227e2e</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:37:20 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><title>🔴 En direct : 82 500 personnes ont manifesté en France selon Beauvau, 150 000 d'après la CGT</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261121-en-direct-acte-vi-de-la-mobilisation-pour-la-jeunesse-et-contre-la-vie-ch%C3%A8re</link><description></description><guid isPermaLink="false">fb1f1182-e5cd-11f1-862d-353259c199a9</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:07:06 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Guerre en Ukraine : deux personnes tuées à Kryvyï Rih</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261121-guerre-en-ukraine-deux-personnes-tu%C3%A9es-%C3%A0-kryvy%C3%AF-rih</link><description>
La Russie a ⁠de nouveau frappé ​dans la nuit de vendredi à samedi 21 novembre des cibles civiles dans la ville industrielle de Kryvyï Rih, ville natale du président Volodymyr Zelensky, où au moins deux personnes ont été tuées, dont un garçon de sept ans.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/28289a0c-e5cb-11f1-abf1-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-170806-170952-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/28289a0c-e5cb-11f1-abf1-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261121-170806-170952-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">2d1ef308-e5cb-11f1-9e96-e5efa9cbfee5</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:04:30 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>COP31 à Antalya : bras de fer autour des énergies fossiles et des financements</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261121-cop31-%C3%A0-antalya-bras-de-fer-autour-des-%C3%A9nergies-fossiles-et-des-financements</link><description>
La 31e ⁠conférence des Nations unies sur ​les changements climatiques (COP31) aboutira soit à un accord satisfaisant, soit à aucun accord, a déclaré samedi 21 novembre le haut responsable de l'Union européenne chargé du climat, alors que les négociations se prolongeaient bien au-delà ​de l'échéance prévue. Nous en parlons avec notre correspondante Jenna Le Bras.

À cinq mois de l’échéance, François Ruffin a annoncé samedi qu’il retirait sa candidature à l’élection présidentielle, prenant "acte de l’impasse" de sa campagne faute d’avoir réussi à imposer l’organisation d’une "grande primaire" de toute la gauche.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">34a0106a-e5d2-11f1-88ab-0f8d44227e2e</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:37:20 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/049bdf84-e5d2-11f1-b9d8-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6J962D.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Syndicats, jeunesse et gilets jaunes un peu moins mobilisés pour le sixième samedi de manifestation</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261121-en-direct-acte-vi-de-la-mobilisation-pour-la-jeunesse-et-contre-la-vie-ch%C3%A8re</link><description>
Pour la sixième semaine consécutive, syndicats, organisations de jeunesse et Gilets jaunes ont manifesté contre la vie chère, dans un contexte de colère sociale devenue européenne mais qui commence à s'essouffler en France. Le ministère de l'Intérieur a dénombré au total 82 500 manifestants dans l'Hexagone, dont 21 500 à Paris. La CGT parle de son côté de 150 000 manifestants dans le pays, 45 000 dans la capitale.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d69a9eb2-e5cd-11f1-820c-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88L88H.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d69a9eb2-e5cd-11f1-820c-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88L88H.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e164d32e-e584-11f1-8432-8fa90dee50f1</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:23:49 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d69a9eb2-e5cd-11f1-820c-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88L88H.jpg">AFP - GUILLAUME SALIGOT</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Entre 80 000 et 150 000 personnes mobilisées pour un sixième samedi de manifestation en France</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261121-sixi%C3%A8me-samedi-de-manifestation-contre-la-vie-ch%C3%A8re-premier-round-contre-les-violences-sexistes</link><description>
Pour la sixième semaine d'affilée, des syndicats, organisations de jeunesse et Gilets jaunes ont appelé à manifester, samedi, contre la vie chère. Malgré une baisse de la mobilisation, 82 500 personnes ont défilé en France selon le ministère de l’intérieur et 150 000 selon les organisateurs.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c7c4cc2e-e5e5-11f1-a66f-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88T7BJ.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c7c4cc2e-e5e5-11f1-a66f-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88T7BJ.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">18084e40-e573-11f1-9a90-2dc31e39031d</guid><pubDate>Sat, 21 Nov 2026 06:16:30 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c7c4cc2e-e5e5-11f1-a66f-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D88T7BJ.jpg">© Romain Perrocheau, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Procès Zecler : les trois policiers condamnés à des peines de un à deux ans de prison ferme</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-proc%C3%A8s-zecler-les-trois-policiers-condamn%C3%A9s-%C3%A0-des-peines-de-un-%C3%A0-deux-ans-de-prison-ferme</link><description>
Les trois policiers ayant passé à tabac le producteur de musique noir Michel Zecler en 2020 ont été condamnés à des peines de un à deux ans de prison ferme. L'accusation avait de son côté requis, jeudi, entre quatre et six ans de prison ferme.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">844245cc-e52b-11f1-ab61-a5c9daa303ca</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 21:54:13 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg">© Benoit PEYRUCQ / AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Au cœur de l’info, l’invité</category><title>Johann Chapoutot : "la dédiabolisation du RN est véritablement un mythe"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/au-c%C5%93ur-de-l-info-l-invit%C3%A9/20261120-johann-chapoutot-la-d%C3%A9diabolisation-du-rn-est-v%C3%A9ritablement-un-mythe</link><description>
A 5 mois de la présidentielle en France, le RN domine toujours dans les sondages. Longtemps considéré comme anti républicain, infréquentable, il est désormais aux portes du pouvoir. Comment comprendre cette progression? Quelle est la responsabilité de la classe politique dans cette évolution? Quelles conséquences sur notre démocratie? Johann Chapoutot, Professeur d'Histoire contemporaine, auteur de "La bascule, Allemagne 1933" (éditions Gallimard), était l'Invité d'Au Coeur de l'Info. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20054536-e522-11f1-9d9f-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-200854-202823-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/20054536-e522-11f1-9d9f-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261120-200854-202823-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">141cd51a-e525-11f1-8891-754dc11be848</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 20:58:03 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Achren VERDIAN</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Police : la loi sur la présomption de légitime défense définitivement adoptée par le Parlement</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-police-la-loi-sur-la-pr%C3%A9somption-de-l%C3%A9gitime-d%C3%A9fense-d%C3%A9finitivement-adopt%C3%A9e-par-le-parlement</link><description>
Vivement combattue dans la rue par ses opposants qui l'assimilent à un "permis de tuer", l'instauration d'une présomption d'usage légal des armes par les forces de l'ordre a été définitivement adoptée au Parlement vendredi soir, à la veille d'une nouvelle journée de mobilisation sociale.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec88460c-e514-11f1-8bce-43bc8e8d3f8d</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 19:02:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/84d2817a-e524-11f1-9187-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C8TV3VK.jpg">© Geoffroy van der Hasselt, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Fuites au ministère de l'Intérieur : comment le RN a progressivement séduit les hauts fonctionnaires</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-fuites-au-minist%C3%A8re-de-l-int%C3%A9rieur-comment-le-rn-a-progressivement-s%C3%A9duit-les-hauts-fonctionnaires</link><description>
Le parquet de Paris soupçonne l'ancien secrétaire général de Beauvau et actuel préfet du Loiret et de la région Centre-Val de Loire, Hugues Moutouh, d'avoir informé le Rassemblement national sur des enquêtes judiciaires visant le parti. Une affaire qui illustre l'influence grandissante du parti lepéniste dans les hautes sphères de l'État.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">845e625a-e4fb-11f1-8ece-9d792c6a9305</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:12:25 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/ed281fb0-e4ec-11f1-b121-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/000-9QL2XA.jpg">© Pascal Guyot, AFP</source><dc:creator>Louis CHAHUNEAU</dc:creator></item><item><category>Outre-Mer</category><title>De l'océan Indien aux Caraïbes, la sécheresse frappe plusieurs territoires d'Outre-mer</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/outre-mer/20261120-de-l-oc%C3%A9an-indien-aux-cara%C3%AFbes-la-s%C3%A9cheresse-frappe-plusieurs-territoires-d-outre-mer</link><description>
La sécheresse s'installe durablement en Outre-mer. Le manque d'eau fragilise les cultures et menace les récoltes aux Antilles et à La Réunion. La situation est également très préoccupante en Guyane, où le niveau du fleuve continue de baisser.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d5ba9aa2-e4f5-11f1-a177-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-e00d5d0f.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">668bbe98-e4ca-11f1-b006-117a06c45e07</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:36:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator></dc:creator></item><item><category>ActuElles</category><title>Les féminicides, la partie émergée du contrôle coercitif</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/actuelles/20261120-les-f%C3%A9minicides-la-partie-%C3%A9merg%C3%A9e-du-contr%C3%B4le-coercitif</link><description>
Les féminicides font aussi des victimes invisibles : les proches des femmes assassinées, confrontées à un deuil impossible et à des embûches judiciaires. Dans 75 % des cas, le féminicide survient sans violences physiques préalables, mais au terme d'une période de contrôle coercitif :  une prison invisible faite d'emprise et de violences psychologiques, explique l'historienne Christelle Taraud, qui décrit des victimes "zombifiées" par leur tortionnaire.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/804fd37e-e4e7-11f1-94db-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/actuelles-4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">012b0ea0-e4e8-11f1-954f-b12e286687bf</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:46:33 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laure MANENT</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Gérard Depardieu et Michel Houellebecq accusés de viol en réunion et d'agressions sexuelles</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-g%C3%A9rard-depardieu-et-michel-houellebecq-accus%C3%A9s-de-viol-en-r%C3%A9union-et-d-agressions-sexuelles</link><description>
Gérard Depardieu est de nouveau accusé de viol – en réunion cette fois, avec la complicité supposée de l'écrivain Michel Houellebecq, selon des sources proches du dossier, confirmant vendredi des révélations de Mediapart. Les faits, dénoncés par une comédienne, remonteraient au tournage du film "Thalasso" en 2018.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">11ebaaf8-e4f0-11f1-af7a-57d065e8beab</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:38:36 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/112bfeb0-e4f0-11f1-97c4-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/5b316d0d8e9e019339c005a7e2173a2aacfd39e4.jpg">© Dimitar Dilkoff, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Dominique de Villepin annonce sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261120-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-l-ancien-premier-ministre-dominique-de-villepin-annonce-sa-candidature</link><description>
Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi 20 novembre sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027. L'ex-Premier ministre se présente comme une alternative au macronisme, à La France insoumise et au Rassemblement national.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9fb85a8a-e4d6-11f1-8eb3-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/miniadefvillepin.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c6c746ae-e4d6-11f1-8ffb-375f4fe00708</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:42:32 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>La députée RN Laure Lavalette se défend d'être antisémite, se dédouane d'écrits vieux de "30 ans"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-accusations-antis%C3%A9mitisme-d%C3%A9put%C3%A9e-rn-laure-lavalette-invoque-faits-vieux-de-30-ans</link><description>
Selon une enquête publiée mercredi par le média Les Jours, la députée du Rassemblement national du Var Laure Lavalette aurait présidé, lors de ses années d'études, un syndicat étudiant dont la revue publiait des écrits antisémites. L'élue a balayé les accusations dans une interview sur BFMTV, arguant de faits vieux de "30 ans".
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">00ba44a8-e4c1-11f1-9390-bd7bd8f937b3</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:26:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1684c9f4-e4bf-11f1-943c-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-A49893B.jpg">© Miguel Medina, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Dominique de Villepin candidat : un homme de droite populaire à gauche mais en quête d'électeurs</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261120-france-presidentielle-2027-dominique-de-villepin-homme-droite-populaire-gauche-sans-electeurs</link><description>
L'ancien Premier ministre Dominique de Villepin a officialisé vendredi sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027. L'homme du "non" de la France à la guerre en Irak en 2003 est revenu sur le devant de la scène ces dernières années pour ses prises de position sur les sujets internationaux, en particulier sur la guerre à Gaza. Mais sa popularité est surtout marquée à gauche, au sein d'un électorat qui ne devrait pas voter pour lui.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c0ca20de-e434-11f1-a9ea-f369f859b733</guid><pubDate>Fri, 20 Nov 2026 06:43:38 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/fd73fc2c-e433-11f1-b4e5-6b451f569414/w:1024/p:16x9/main-Villepin.png">© AFP / Studio graphique, FMM</source><dc:creator>Romain BRUNET</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Yannick Jadot claque la porte des Écologistes suite au rapprochement entre Marine Tondelier et LFI</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-france-presidentielle-yannick-jadot-quitte-les-ecologistes-marine-tondelier-jean-luc-melenchon-glucksmann</link><description>
Les fractures deviennent apparentes chez les Écologistes, au lendemain de la main tendue de Marine Tondelier à Jean-Luc Mélenchon : Yannick Jadot, sénateur et ex-candidat écologiste à la présidentielle, a annoncé qu'il quittait le parti, tout comme le député Jérémie Iordanoff. </description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">819cc766-e46d-11f1-9bfb-ffca175961e0</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 23:04:16 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2434c0c2-b5b2-11ec-ac2b-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/France-Elysee2022-YannickJadot.jpg">© Damien Meyer, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Politique</category><title>Présidentielle 2027 : primaire de la droite et du centre, Marine Tondelier tend la main à LFI</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/politique/20261119-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-primaire-de-la-droite-et-du-centre-marine-tondelier-tend-la-main-%C3%A0-lfi</link><description>

Jusqu'à deux ans de prison ferme ont été requis, jeudi à Paris, contre le fondateur du groupe Telegram "femmeblancherie" et six autres hommes, jugés pour des propos haineux visant notamment les femmes, dans le premier procès de la mouvance masculiniste en France.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">36382846-e45a-11f1-a6dc-e13af9138cc0</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 21:15:19 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/66fe4cc0-e45b-11f1-ab87-e56ab3dc0809/w:1024/p:16x9/000-326Q46X.jpg">© AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Au procès Zecler, prison ferme requise contre les policiers, qui se défendent de tout racisme</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-au-proc%C3%A8s-zecler-prison-ferme-requise-contre-les-policiers-qui-se-d%C3%A9fendent-de-tout-racisme</link><description>
L'accusation a requis jeudi entre quatre et six ans de prison ferme contre les trois policiers ayant passé à tabac le producteur de musique noir Michel Zecler en 2020. La défense reconnait des "violences inadmissibles" mais conteste la lourdeur des peines requises et rejette toute dimension raciste.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0e8098a2-e445-11f1-9e16-9f17a13d179f</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:14:26 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0daede70-e445-11f1-aa9e-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/6eafad5bb555456f4505bd99516b8a173e5764e7.jpg">© Benoit Peyrucq, AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Présidentielle : les créateurs de contenus sommés de respecter le pluralisme par l'Arcom</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-cr%C3%A9ateurs-contenus-somm%C3%A9s-respecter-pluralisme-arcom</link><description>
Créateurs de contenus et influenceurs devront pour la première fois respecter les règles du pluralisme pendant la campagne de la présidentielle 2027, au même titre que la radio et la télévision, a annoncé jeudi le régulateur de l'audiovisuel et du numérique. En cas de manquements répétés, l'Arcom pourra décider de sanctions financières. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8d488a52-e42f-11f1-aa64-9157722348a5</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:07:37 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1246ec08-e430-11f1-b9da-1bac47ab2f5d/w:1024/p:16x9/000-32687U6.jpg">© Joël Saget, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Le RN visé par une nouvelle enquête autour de fuites impliquant un préfet</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261119-le-rn-vis%C3%A9-par-une-nouvelle-enqu%C3%AAte-autour-de-fuites-impliquant-un-pr%C3%A9fet</link><description>
À quelques mois de la présidentielle, le siège du Rassemblement national, ainsi que le ministère de l'Intérieur, ont été perquisitionnés par des juges d'instruction dans le cadre d'une nouvelle affaire judiciaire liée à des soupçons de fuites d'informations vers le RN, impliquant un préfet.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">4c941b6e-e440-11f1-92f2-af61307a37ad</guid><pubDate>Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:40:23 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0cecf33c-e445-11f1-91e4-13439ca2fe89/w:1024/p:16x9/ec3a5b7b2f106b3dc8864450a3619a771fda0000.jpg">© Alain Jocard, AFP/Archives</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Les clés de l'info</category><title>"Femmeblancherie" : le procès de la haine des femmes</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/les-cl%C3%A9s-de-l-info/20261118-femmeblancherie-le-proc%C3%A8s-de-la-haine-des-femmes</link><description>
Ce mercredi s’est ouvert le procès de sept membres du canal Telegram "Femmeblancherie" au tribunal judiciaire de Paris. Appels aux féminicides et aux viols, fichages racistes et homophobes, plusieurs dizaines d’abonnés sont accusés d’une trentaine de crimes et délits, dont "provocation publique à commettre un crime". Un procès qui découle d’une idéologie très en vogue chez les jeunes, notamment sur les réseaux sociaux : le masculinisme.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3a6bb852-e3a5-11f1-b778-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FRAN261118-2339-Live-CS2339.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/3a6bb852-e3a5-11f1-b778-6d75ed565170/w:1024/p:16x9/FRAN261118-2339-Live-CS2339.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">53cba342-e3a6-11f1-92ea-c561305b4ba1</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 23:18:12 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Cécile GALLUCCIO</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Présidentielle : Marine Tondelier "prête à travailler à une coalition" autour de Jean-Luc Mélenchon</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261118-presidentielle-2027-election-marine-tondelier-ecologistes-prete-travailler-coalition-autour-jean-luc-melenchon-la-france-insoumise-soutien</link><description>
Qualifiant la dynamique de campagne de Jean-Luc Mélenchon d'"indéniable", la candidate écologiste à la présidentielle, Marine Tondelier, a dit mercredi soir sur France 2 être "prête" à "travailler à une coalition" avec l'insoumis. Le candidat Raphaël Glucksmann a jugé qu'elle "[tournait] le dos" à "la tradition profondément proeuropéenne" des écologistes.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">474d52e2-e3a0-11f1-a2ae-77a83e8869af</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 22:39:24 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2fab2b82-e3a0-11f1-9252-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D7ED2CR.jpg">© Geoffroy Van Der Hasselt, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>"Les taxes, ils les boufferont" : Mélenchon et le controversé dîner avec des grands patrons</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261118-les-taxes-ils-les-boufferont-m%C3%A9lenchon-et-le-controvers%C3%A9-d%C3%AEner-avec-des-grands-patrons</link><description>
Le candidat de la France insoumise à l'élection présidentielle française de 2027, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a dîné, mardi, avec les 13 plus grands patrons français. Un événement qui étonne pour le leader de la gauche radicale en rupture avec le capitalisme et fervent critique des ultra-riches.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d2d81b72-e372-11f1-a389-ad8030967382</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:09:31 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f109998a-e396-11f1-b121-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-16T201716Z-1136734044-RC28POAG8YL6-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-POLITICS.jpg">© Kenzo Tribouillard, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>France : le comté du Fort des Rousses élu meilleur fromage du monde</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-france-le-comt%C3%A9-du-fort-des-rousses-%C3%A9lu-meilleure-fromage-du-monde</link><description>
Le meilleur fromage du monde a été désigné hier parmi les 5 000 produits en lice, une la quarantaine de pays en compétition. La médaille d'or a été décernée à un fromage français : le comté du fort des Rousses, petite commune près de la frontière suisse. Une consécration qui fait la fierté de toute la région.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/396b2754-e36d-11f1-8c50-7908c4e1a3c7/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-171130-171324-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/396b2754-e36d-11f1-8c50-7908c4e1a3c7/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-171130-171324-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3ea64eb0-e36d-11f1-8b87-310c2914a920</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:42:17 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>C'est en France</category><title>Élection présidentielle française 2027 – épisode 2 : le grand flou</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/c-est-en-france/20261118-%C3%A9lection-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-fran%C3%A7aise-2027-%E2%80%93-%C3%A9pisode-2-le-grand-flou</link><description>
Au printemps prochain, la France se rendra aux urnes pour élire un nouveau président de la République. Trente-huit candidats sont actuellement en lice et ont jusqu'au 12 mars pour obtenir 500 parrainages. Aujourd'hui, quels que soient les candidats, les sondages donnent Marine Le Pen en tête du premier et du second tour.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4e62cfbc-e337-11f1-b040-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/confused-french.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/4e62cfbc-e337-11f1-b040-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/confused-french.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0794d444-e1cb-11f1-a708-c555493b4fb3</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:57:16 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Joanna COCKERELL</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Présidentielle 2027 : le candidat Édouard Philippe veut "oser des réformes radicales"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261118-pr%C3%A9sidentielle-2027-le-candidat-%C3%A9douard-philippe-veut-oser-des-r%C3%A9formes-radicales</link><description>
Lors d'une conférence de presse de présentation de son programme pour l'élection présidentielle, Édouard Philippe a affirmé mercredi 18 novembre que "nous devons oser des réformes radicales, en rupture avec ce qui a été fait ces dernières années". Le candidat Horizons de nouveau affirmé son refus à l'idée de participer à une primaire de la droite. Les précisions de Flore Simon, chroniqueuse politique à France 24.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7ab0c0c0-e359-11f1-9c83-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-141103-141859-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/7ab0c0c0-e359-11f1-9c83-c5c0357b2a0c/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261118-141103-141859-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">82fa8cca-e359-11f1-a9a9-fb22cf0d552d</guid><pubDate>Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:48:46 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>
